title: GTM Canonicals — Vertical Entry
description: Thin schema per ADR-016 (D7). One file per vertical under plugins/marketing/data/canonicals/{slug}.yaml. _manifest.yaml shape is documented in #/definitions/manifest. Brite repo is stdlib-only — this schema is the declarative contract; plugins/marketing/scripts/lint_canonicals.py is the runtime enforcement (it mirrors the constraints below).

slug.description: Strict kebab-case canonical slug. Matches filename ({slug}.yaml). No trailing or doubled hyphens.

aliases.description: Optional. Kebab-case slugs that should resolve to this vertical (for renames). Must not collide with any canonical vertical slug or another vertical's alias.

playbook_path.description: Optional. Path to handbook playbook README, relative to handbook root.

personas.description: May be empty for skeleton entries (per D11).

offers.description: May be empty for skeleton entries (per D11).

titles.description: >=1 required (drives list-building title cascade per ADR-016).

target_personas.description: Each entry must resolve to a persona.slug in the same vertical (enforced by lint_canonicals.py).

target_postures.description: Optional advisory per ADR-017 §57-62. Each campaign-instance posture may override.

replaced_by.description: Forward-pointer to the offer slug that supersedes this one (must reference a sibling offer.slug in the same vertical).

iterates_from.description: Reverse-pointer to the offer slug this one iterates on (must reference a sibling offer.slug in the same vertical).

prose_path.description: Optional. Path to handbook offer prose, relative to handbook root.

manifest.$comment: Shape of _manifest.yaml. Enforced by plugins/marketing/scripts/lint_canonicals.py (Brite repo has no jsonschema runtime dependency).

schema_version.description: Pinned to the linter's SCHEMA_VERSION constant. Bump in lockstep with the linter + data shape.

verticals.description: Alphabetized + duplicate-free list of canonical vertical slugs.
